## Introduction

`summaryBiologicalVar()` gives a quick overview of the biological variables
(BV table) in an RDBES Data Object. For one or more measured variables (e.g.`Age`,
`LengthTotal`, `WeightLive`, `Sex` or `Maturity`) it counts how many
individuals were measured, split by one or more grouping fields and restricted 
to the selected year(s).

The result can be returned as:

- a **table** of counts (`outputType = "table"`),
- a **histogram** (numeric variables) or **bar plot** (non-numeric variables), faceted by the grouping field(`outputType = "plot"`),
- optionally, a **box plot with summary statistics** (`statistics = TRUE`).

## Load packages

```{r packages, message=FALSE}
library(RDBEScore)
library(RDBESvisualise)
```

## Load and prepare data

The function expects a validated RDBES Data Object containing at least the
`SA`, `DE`, `SD`, `FM` and `BV` tables. In this vignette the example dataset 
H8ExampleEE1 from RDBEScore is used. Your own data can be loaded with 
`RDBEScore::createRDBESDataObject()`.

```{r data}
H8RDBESobjEE <- RDBEScore::H8ExampleEE1
```

The object is validated inside the function
(`RDBEScore::validateRDBESDataObject(strict = TRUE)`), so an invalid object
stops with an informative error before any summarising is done.

It is worth checking which variables and years are present before calling
the function:

```{r explore}
unique(H8RDBESobjEE$BV$BVtypeMeas)   # measured variables available for `var`
unique(H8RDBESobjEE$DE$DEyear)       # years available for `year`
```

## Arguments

| Argument     | Description |
|--------------|-------------|
| `data`       | RDBES Data Object (masterTable with SA, DE, SD, FM, BV). |
| `verbose`    | `TRUE` prints informative messages from the RDBEScore helpers. Default `FALSE`. |
| `var`        | One or more biological variables, matching a value of `BVtypeMeas` (e.g. `"Age"`). |
| `by`         | One or more fields used to split the data, e.g. `"SDctry"`, `"DEyear"` or `"SAsampler"`. |
| `year`       | One or more years to keep (filters on `DEyear`). |
| `outputType` | `"table"` and/or `"plot"`. The default is both. |
| `statistics` | `TRUE` adds a box plot and a statistics table. Default `FALSE`. |
| `bins`       | Number of bins in histograms. Default is 20.|

## How it works

1. **Validation** – the RDBES Data Object is checked with
   `validateRDBESDataObject()`.
2. **Argument checks** – if `var` is not found in `BVtypeMeas` the function
   stops and lists the variables that are available. Years in `year` that are
   not in `DEyear` produce a warning (not an error).
3. **Filtering** – the object is filtered to the requested years with
   `filterRDBESDataObject(killOrphans = TRUE)`, so records no longer linked
   to a kept design row are removed.
4. **Linking** – `getLinkedDataFromLevel()` attaches each BV record to the
   value of the `by` field it belongs to.
5. **Plotting** – numeric variables are shown as histograms with bins intervals 
   (Age with a bin width of 1); non-numeric variables (e.g. Sex, Maturity) as bar plots.

## Examples

### Age by country, as a table

```{r table}
H8AgebyCtryTab <- summaryBiologicalVar(
  data = H8RDBESobjEE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  var = "Age",
  by = "SDctry",
  year = 2022,
  outputType = "table",
  statistics = FALSE
)

H8AgebyCtryTab$countTable
```

Each row shows the number of fish for which age has been reported in the RDBES for a given country.

### Age by country, as a plot

```{r plot}
H8AgebyCtryPlot <- summaryBiologicalVar(
  data = H8RDBESobjEE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  var = "Age",
  by = "SDctry",
  year = 2022,
  outputType = "plot",
  statistics = FALSE
)

H8AgebyCtryPlot$plots$Age
```

The plot has one panel per value of `by`; the x axis shows the values of
`var` and the y axis the number of individuals.

### Selecting several years and splitting by statistical rectangle

The `year` argument only selects the data – it does not split the results by year.
If some of the requested years are not present in the data, the function gives
a warning naming them and continues with the years that are available. The
caption of the plot shows which years were actually used.

```{r years}
H8sampler <- summaryBiologicalVar(
  data = H8RDBESobjEE,
  var = "Age",
  by = c("LEstatRect"),
  year = c(2022, 2024, 2025),
  outputType = "plot",
  statistics = FALSE
)
H8sampler$plots$Age
```

To see the results **for each year separately**, add `DEyear` to `by`.

### Adding summary statistics

```{r stats}
H8stat <- summaryBiologicalVar(
  data = H8RDBESobjEE,
  var = "Age",
  by = "SDctry",
  year = 2022,
  outputType = "plot",
  statistics = TRUE
)

H8stat$statsTable
```

With `statistics = TRUE` a histogram and a box plot of the values (mean marked 
with a cross) are drawn above a table of summary statistics (n, mean, sd, median,
min, max).

### Age by hierarchy 

The function works on one hierarchy at a time. To compare several hierarchies,
run the function separately for each RDBES Data Object and combine the results.

```{r plot_combine}
H8AgePlot <- summaryBiologicalVar(
  data = H8RDBESobjEE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  var = "Age",
  by = c("DEhierarchy"),
  outputType = "plot",
  statistics = FALSE
)

H1AgePlot <- summaryBiologicalVar(
  data = RDBEScore::H1Example,
  verbose = FALSE,
  var = "Age",
  by = c("DEhierarchy"),
  outputType = "plot",
  statistics = FALSE
)

cols <- c("DEhierarchy", "valueNum")
ageData <- rbind(
  H8AgePlot$plots$Age$data[, cols, with = FALSE],
  H1AgePlot$plots$Age$data[, cols, with = FALSE]
)

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(ageData, aes(x = valueNum)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, center = 0,
                 fill = RDBESvisualise::colourPalette[2], color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ DEhierarchy) +
  labs(title = "Number of individuals by Age and DEhierarchy",
       x = "Age", y = "Number of individuals") +
  theme_light()

```

## Common errors

- **"The given measure type ---> X <--- is not present in the data"** –
  `var` does not match any `BVtypeMeas` value. The message lists the valid
  values; spelling and case must be the same as in RDBES documentation (ICESvocab).
- **Warning about missing years** – some years in `year` are not in `DEyear`.
  Check `unique(data$DE$DEyear)`.
- **Validation error** – the input is not a valid RDBES Data Object; see the
  RDBEScore documentation on `createRDBESDataObject()`.
